battle.name: 魏宋河南之戰
battle.brief: 景平三年（422年）春，劉宋武帝劉裕臥病，北魏晉王拓跋燾乘隙出兵：斛黎如將騎兵五萬寇青州，叔建將步騎三萬逼河南，渡黃河趨滑臺。宋遣檀道濟往救，收復滑臺，終因糧援不繼，以唱籌量沙之計全軍而還。魏軍略地數十郡縣，河南藩籬洞開。卡面這件羅馬弩砲，即當年壓制城頭的攻城器械。

kit.name: 羅馬弩砲
kit.history: 扭力弩砲，一發一具箭。羅馬用它拆掉希臘的城牆，也拆掉了希臘的城邦體系。

countries: 魏宋河南之戰是公元422年北魏與劉宋在黃河南岸爆發的一場大規模邊境戰爭。北魏一方由在位的明元帝拓跋晃主持，實際掌軍的是其弟晉王拓跋燾（後世稱太武帝，時任司徒）。北庭諸部在什翼犍、明元帝兩朝經營下盡歸王室，控弦之士號稱百餘萬，軍制上分中軍、鎮軍與部騎，遠征時以略陽公斛黎如統騎兵五萬攻略青州、泰山，以尚書叔建將步騎三萬沿太行東麓南下，取河內、陳留一帶的渡口與倉城，平城留守則節制後援與糧秣。劉宋一方以武帝劉裕的北伐軍為骨幹，倚仗青州、兗州、豫州、司州四州的郡縣與黃河天險，兵制沿用漢晉以來募兵與軍屯並行之法，諸州刺史各領部曲，中央以征東大將軍檀道濟總督河南戰事。戰爭爆發時劉裕正在病中，帝位尚未交割，樞密與外鎮之間缺乏統一節制，宋軍雖據城池之利，卻難以協同作戰。南北兩國在河南形成拉鋸已歷數十年，誰能控制滑臺、虎牢一線，誰就能把防線推到對方的平原上。
countriesEn: The Henan Campaign of 422 was a large-scale frontier war fought between Northern Wei and the Liu Song court south of the Yellow River. On the Wei side the host was ordered by the reigning Emperor Mingyuan, Tuoba Huang, while the command in the field was in the hands of his brother the Prince Jin, Tuoba Tao, afterwards known as the Taiwu emperor and then holding the office of sikong. The tribes of the northern steppe had been gathered to the throne through the reigns of Tuoba Shiyijian and Tuoba Huang, the state claimed a hundred thousand and more archers, and its army was divided into a central army, regional garrisons and tribal horse; for the southern thrust the Duke of Lüeyang, Huliuru, led fifty thousand horse towards Qingzhou and Mount Tai, while the minister Shujian took thirty thousand foot and horse down the eastern flank of the Taihang range towards the crossings and granaries of Henei and Chenliu, and the garrison left at Pingguo directed the reinforcements and the grain. Liu Song, for its part, built on the northern expeditionary army of Emperor Wu Liu Yu and relied on the provinces of Qingzhou, Yanzhou, Yuzhou and Sizhou together with the Yellow River itself, its system mixing recruited men with military colonies in the fashion of the Han and Jin; the provincial governors commanded their own contingents, and the centre sent the Marquis of the East, Tan Daoji, to take overall charge of the operations in Henan. The war broke out while Liu Yu lay ill and the succession had not been settled, so command and field coordination between the capital and the provincial strongholds were broken at the moment they mattered most. The two courts had disputed the Henan plain for decades, and whoever held Huatai and Hulao could push the line onto the other's territory.
people: 魏方實際統軍者為晉王拓跋燾，後世稱太武帝。他自 409 年以晉王掌軍政，北方整合尚未完成，關中的赫連夏要到 427 年才滅，漠北柔然亦未大定，故此役係一次以試探為主的南征，而唔係北方已統一後嘅全力進攻；渡河的次序、渡點的取捨與糧秣的籌畫都由他拍板，名義上則奉在位的明元帝拓跋晃之命出兵。參謀其間的是侍中崔浩，此人熟悉漢地史地與山川形勢，向魏主陳述南朝虛實與進兵次第。前線的兩名將領是略陽公斛黎如與尚書叔建：斛黎如驍勇善騎，領騎兵五萬自北而南直趨青州、泰山；叔建持節督步騎三萬，循太行東麓而南，目標是河內、滑臺一線的渡口與城邑。宋方主持者是征東大將軍檀道濟，自劉裕創業便以能戰聞名，此番率眾北拒，屢與魏騎周旋於黃河南岸，進至滑臺收復失地，終因糧道被斷、援兵不繼而退，退時以唱籌量沙之計懾住追兵，保全全軍而返。劉裕本人於同年六月病歿於宮中，少帝劉義符即位，劉義隆以侍中錄尚書事柄政，朝廷隨即在猜忌中下令誅除檀道濟及其諸子，二十八年後魏軍再度南下，江南便再無一人可以當之。
peopleEn: On the Wei side the command in the field was in the hands of the Prince Jin, Tuoba Tao, afterwards known as the Taiwu emperor. He had directed the military affairs of the state as Prince Jin since 409, and the north was still not united when he moved: the Xia of Helian would not fall in the Guanzhong until 427 and the Rouran had not yet been settled on the northern steppe, so this campaign was a southern probe rather than a full-weight thrust by a state that had finished its northern reunification; he settled the order of the crossings, the choice of the fords and the provisioning of the army, and acted in the name of the reigning Emperor Mingyuan, Tuoba Huang. His adviser was Cui Hao, who knew the geography and the historical record of the Han lands and briefed the court on the condition of the south and the order of advance. The two field commanders were Huliuru and Shujian: Huliuru, a fierce cavalryman, led fifty thousand horse south by way of Qingzhou and Mount Tai, while Shujian, carrying the tally of authority, led thirty thousand foot and horse down the eastern flank of the Taihang range towards the crossings and towns of Henei and Huatai. The Song side was led by Tan Daoji, Marquis of the East, who had served Liu Yu since the founding of the state and was known as a general in the field; in this campaign he met the Wei horse repeatedly along the south bank of the Yellow River, advanced to Huatai and retook the lost ground, and finally withdrew when his supply road was cut and no relief came, and on the retreat he used the stratagem of counting the sand while measuring the grain, frightening off the pursuers and bringing the whole army back. Liu Yu himself died in the palace that June; the Lesser Emperor Liu Yifu ascended, Liu Yilong took charge of the Secretariat as a chancellor, and the court, out of suspicion, soon had Tan Daoji and his sons executed, so that twenty-eight years later, when the Wei host came south again, there was nobody left in the south who could meet it.
kits: 卡面這件羅馬弩砲是扭力儲能的單發重弩，一發一矢，以扭力簧束儲能、靠機件把箭矢加速射出，射程可及二百步上下，是羅馬攻城與野戰中用來壓制城頭、掩護作業的標準器械。漢末以來，同源的扭力機械在中國亦已出現：曹洪在官渡造霹靂車破袁軍攻車，之後各處軍鎮的車弩、石弩與弩機，與羅馬弩砲正屬同一機械家族。五胡各國與南朝的軍鎮器械譜幾乎互襲：北魏的攻城部隊配備撞車、雲梯、火箭與投石車，騎兵則攜帶可拆裝的強弩與步盾；劉宋在城頭列萬弩一類的排弩，居高臨下覆射，並以撞竿、飛火、礌石對付雲梯與披甲兵。此役中器械的關鍵不在射程而在配合：魏軍自遠處以弩砲與投石車壓制城頭，同時讓撞車抵近城壁撞擊女牆，騎兵趁隙自缺口突入；宋軍則倚城塹與弩陣拖住對手，使魏騎無法展開包抄。須說明的是，卡面這把羅馬弩砲並非此戰的實配兵器，而是同一原理在地中海一側的成熟形態，用以說明扭力投射器在當時攻城戰爭中的位置。
kitsEn: The card shows a Roman scorpio, a torsion-powered single-shot heavy crossbow: it looses one bolt at a time, stores its energy in bundled skeins of torsion and drives the bolt out to a range of roughly two hundred paces, and in Roman hands it was the standard instrument for silencing walls and covering the work of a siege. From the late Han onward the same mechanical family had appeared in China as well: Cao Hong's stone-throwing Pili Che broke the Yuan siege works at Guandu, and the cart crossbows, stone crossbows and bolt-throwers of the frontier arsenals of the Wei and Jin belong to that lineage, the same lineage as the Roman scorpio. The inventories of the northern and southern states in this age borrowed freely from one another: the Wei besiegers brought up ram cars, scaling ladders, fire pots and stone-throwers, and their horse carried collapsible strong bows and shields; Song set rows of massed crossbows along the parapet so that volleys fell from above, and answered ladders and armoured men with striking beams, fire and stones. In the fighting around Henan the machines mattered less for their range than for their coordination: Wei silenced the parapets from a distance with bolt-throwers and stone-throwers so that ram cars could close against the wall, and the horse then poured through the breach; Song held the enemy with the ditch, the wall and the crossbow line long enough that the Wei horse could never deploy for a flanking move. It should be said that the Roman scorpio on the card was not the weapon actually issued in this campaign; it is the mature form of the same principle on the Mediterranean side, shown to indicate the place torsion artillery held in the siege warfare of the age.
tactics: 魏軍的戰法以騎兵機動為主軸。出兵之初，斛黎如的騎兵並不急於求戰，而是沿黃河北岸的堤道與荒地南下，避開宋軍的正面鋒芒，等候渡口與糧秣點就位；叔建的步騎以攻取城邑為任務，逐個拔除黃河南岸的縣治與烽燧，切斷宋境自彭城、淮北通往洛陽的糧道。突破之後，魏騎不戀戰於一城一池，而是縱兵掠地直趨青州、泰山，使宋方邊兵四處馳援而無法集中。劉宋的應對則是守城為主、出兵為輔：各州郡縣閉城自守，援軍集中於檀道濟一路，力圖在滑臺一線頂住魏騎，等其銳氣既衰、糧秣不繼再行反擊。檀道濟的選擇最具攻擊性，他主動北上，收復滑臺一帶，把魏軍拖入河南腹地，再以疑兵與聲勢迫其退走；唱籌量沙正是這套戰術的精髓，撤退時刻意讓敵人以為糧草無虞，放棄追擊。其弱點亦在此，一支深入敵後的孤軍若糧道被斷，反擊便無從談起，士氣與機動力在黃河南岸的平原上一寸寸流失。
tacticsEn: The Wei method was built around cavalry mobility. At the start of the advance Huliuru's horse did not press the attack but moved down the north bank of the Yellow River along dikes and open waste, keeping away from the Song spearhead while waiting for the crossings and the depots to be ready; Shujian's foot and horse, whose task was to take towns, worked up one county seat and beacon tower after another along the south bank, cutting the grain road that ran from Pengcheng and the Huai valley towards Luoyang. Once the line was broken the Wei horse did not linger over any single city but swept the country towards Qingzhou and Mount Tai, spreading the Song frontier garrisons so that they could not concentrate. The Song answer was to hold cities and to send out relief: the provincial towns shut their gates and the relief column concentrated on Tan Daoji, hoping to pin the Wei horse at Huatai until its momentum had spent itself and its supplies had run dry, and only then to counterattack. Tan Daoji's own choice was the most aggressive of all: he pushed north, retook Huatai and the country around it, drew the enemy deep into the Henan plain, and then used deception and noise to force it to withdraw; the counting of sand while measuring the grain was the essence of that method, a withdrawal staged so that the enemy would believe the grain was plentiful and give up the pursuit. Its weakness was the one that always defeats a single column operating deep in enemy territory: once the supply road was cut, counterattack became impossible, and morale and mobility drained away inch by inch on the open plains south of the Yellow River.
data: 兵力方面，通鑑所記魏軍投入的數字是斛黎如領騎兵五萬、叔建領步騎三萬，合兵在八萬上下；宋方以檀道濟所部為主力，總數在數萬之譜，諸州郡縣的守軍與民兵另計。地理上，魏軍自平城、河內一線南下，最遠抵青州、泰山，前後縱深數百里；滑臺在今河南滑縣一帶，距建康近千里，黃河沿線數處渡口是兩軍爭點，黃河之水則同時是魏軍的補給線與宋軍的天然屏障。時間上，此役自景平三年春末出師，至泰始四年即公元423年魏軍再出、進逼瓜步（建康西北、距江數十里）而退，延續約一年。戰果方面，魏軍在河南與青州方向略地數十郡縣，被俘與淪陷的編戶以萬計，劉宋此後失去自洛陽、虎牢一線至泰山的屏障；宋軍損失的具體數字史無明確記載，但從魏軍深入三百餘里而未被正面擋截推知，前線郡縣的守軍多以潰散與潰退收場。器械方面，攻城一方每次推進都要付出相當數量的撞車、雲梯與強弩損耗，這也是河南諸城在被攻破後多數殘破的原因。
dataEn: On the numbers, the sources record fifty thousand horse under Huliuru and thirty thousand foot and horse under Shujian, which gives a Wei force of some eighty thousand in all; the Song field army was centred on Tan Daoji's column and numbered tens of thousands, with the garrisons and the levies of the counties counted separately. Geographically the advance ran from the Pingguo and Henei lines all the way to Qingzhou and Mount Tai, a depth of several hundred li, with Huatai in the present Huaxian of Henan close to a thousand li from Jiankang, the crossings of the Yellow River as the points of contention, and the river itself serving at once as the Wei supply artery and the Song natural defence. In time the campaign opened in the late spring of the third year of the Jingping era and closed when the Wei host came out again in the fourth year of Taishi, 423, pressed up to Guabu north-west of Jiankang and then withdrew, so that it ran for roughly a year. As to results, the Wei took a number of commanderies and counties in Henan and Qingzhou, and the households that fell under their control or were carried off are counted in tens of thousands; Song lost the screen of Luoyang, Hulao and the line east to Mount Tai, and although the Song losses are given exactly nowhere in the histories, the fact that the enemy advanced several hundred li without being checked head-on shows that most frontier garrisons ended in flight and dispersal. On the materiel side every push of the besiegers cost them rams, ladders and strong bows in quantity, which is why the Henan cities stood in ruins after they fell.
cause: 促成此役的有三層原因。最直接的是劉宋內部的權力交接：景平三年春，劉裕自二月起臥病，東宮與外鎮的人事安排尚未定案，禁軍與州鎮的指揮權出現空隙，這在南北對峙的邊境上是致命的空檔。其次是北魏自身的戰略需求。拓跋燾自 409 年攝政以來，北庭諸部雖已大致臣服，關中仍有赫連夏割據、漠北柔然時常入犯，而南面的中原始終在劉宋手中，黃河兩岸的分野使北魏無法取得完整的糧源與兵源；正因北方統一尚未完成，他只能先以一次中等規模的南征試探劉宋的虛實，目標是河內、滑臺、青州數處，既可取得河南的人力物資，也能把防線推到淮水一線。第三是河南地區本身的反覆：劉裕自義熙年間北伐以來已把洛陽及黃河南岸大部收歸劉宋，這片土地是南朝最靠近北方騎兵的橋頭堡，也是魏軍每次南下必爭之地；此前數年雙方互遣使節、往來商旅的正常局面，也隨劉裕病重與拓跋燾整軍而漸趨緊張，戰爭的導火線正落在這個空窗上。
causeEn: Three layers of reason lie behind the campaign. The most immediate was the change of power inside Liu Song: from the second month of the third year of the Jingping era the emperor lay bedridden, the arrangements for the crown prince and for the provincial commands had not been settled, and a gap had opened in the command of the guards and the provincial governors, which on a northern frontier is a fatal opening. Second was the strategic need of Northern Wei itself. Since taking over the military affairs of the state in 409 the tribes of the northern steppe had indeed submitted in general, but the Xia of Helian still held the Guanzhong and the Rouran still raided the northern marches, while the Central Plain remained in the hands of Liu Song, and the division along the Yellow River meant that Wei could not obtain a full supply of grain and men. Precisely because the northern reunification was unfinished, he could only first send a campaign of moderate size to sound out the condition of Liu Song, aiming at Henei, Huatai and Qingzhou, so as to take the manpower and the goods of Henan and push the line forward to the Huai. Third was the very nature of the Henan region: since his northern expeditions of the Yixi era Liu Yu had brought Luoyang and most of the country south of the Yellow River back into Song hands, and this territory was the bridgehead nearest to the northern horse, contested by every Wei incursion. The envoys and the caravans that had passed between the two states for years had also grown tense as Liu Yu's illness deepened and Tuoba Tao reorganised his forces, and the spark fell into that opening.
impact: 此役的後果超出一次邊境攻防的範圍。對北魏而言，河南的取得意味著第一次把北方統治的邊界推到了南朝的家門：陳留、泰山、琅邪一帶的編戶與屯田落入版圖，糧秣與兵源的供應從此不再完全倚賴平城。隨後魏在平定赫連夏之後重建洛陽、移民實邊，魏國重心南移的格局就此奠定，七十餘年後孝文帝遷都洛陽，走的正是此役打開的這條路。對劉宋而言，代價更為沉重：河南既失，長江以北便只剩淮南與零星據點，國防線被推回淮水；少帝劉義符又在劉義隆的推動下誅殺了唯一能獨當一面的名將檀道濟，人才斷層加上地理退守，使宋廷此後對北魏的每一次進攻都缺乏把握，二十八年後魏主傾國南下直抵瓜步、臨江而不得渡的舊事重演，宋只能再靠盱眙一線的守城與名將的膽略抵擋。從長時段看，此役也確定了南北朝前期以黃河至淮水一線為大致分界的均勢格局，雙方往後的拉鋸多在這條線上展開。
impactEn: The consequences of the campaign reached well beyond a border raid. For Northern Wei, the acquisition of Henan meant pushing the frontier of northern rule for the first time up to the gates of the southern courts: the households and the fields of Chenliu, Mount Tai and Langya entered the registers of the empire, and grain and men no longer had to come wholly from Pingguo. When Wei afterwards crushed the Xia of Helian it rebuilt Luoyang and moved people into the border districts; the southward shift of the Wei centre of gravity was founded on what this campaign opened, and it was the road the Xiaowen emperor followed more than seventy years later when he moved the capital to Luoyang. For Liu Song the cost was heavier: with Henan lost, everything north of the Yangtze was reduced to the Huai valley and a handful of outposts, and the frontier was pushed back to the river. The Lesser Emperor Liu Yifu, acting on the counsel of the regent Liu Yilong, had the one general capable of holding the north alone, Tan Daoji, executed, so that the Song court had nobody in whom to place confidence when it came to offensive operations; twenty-eight years later the Wei host came down with the whole strength of the empire to Guabu, stood on the bank of the river without crossing, and the old story repeated itself, with Song saved only by stubborn defence at Xuyi and by the nerve of its commanders. In the long run the campaign fixed the balance of the early Northern and Southern dynasties along a line that ran, roughly, from the Yellow River to the Huai, and the seesaw of later decades was fought out along that line.
result: 戰事以魏軍全面退入河北、但河南大片土地仍留在魏朝控制之下告終。劉宋失去了洛陽與山東、河南一線的屏障，青州、兗州、豫州的邊防退到淮水與山東丘陵之間，全國轉為守江；北魏則取得河南的編戶與土地，泰始三年即427年平定赫連夏後重建洛陽、移民實邊，把中原的農業與人口收編為國家的資源。對宋廷而言，這一仗的直接結果是慘敗：檀道濟的北伐無功而還，少帝即位後更在數月之內將這位元勳誅除，令朝中再無敢出兵的宿將，隨即在元嘉初年轉向排斥舊門、倚重寒門的用人之路。對掌軍的拓跋燾而言，此役的成果則是戰略的而非決戰的：他確認了南朝邊防空虛、可以隨時敲打的判斷，卻也看到南朝仍有守城與名將的實力，於是數年之內再未傾國來攻，改以每年出兵擾邊、逐步蠶食的辦法，把兵力用在最能擴張的地方。雙方就這樣在河南這片平原上拉開一場長達四十餘年的消耗戰，直到北魏分裂、南朝北伐失敗，這段以黃河為線的僵持才被打破。
resultEn: The war ended with the Wei army withdrawing back to the north, but with a large part of Henan still in Wei hands. Liu Song lost the screen of Luoyang and the belt through Shandong and Henan, the frontier of Qingzhou, Yanzhou and Yuzhou fell back to the Huai and the hills of eastern Shandong, and the state turned to the defensive along the river. Northern Wei took over the households and the land of Henan and, after crushing the Xia of Helian in the third year of Taishi, rebuilt Luoyang and settled the border, converting the agriculture and the population of the Central Plain into resources of the state. For the Song court the direct result was a defeat: the northern expedition of Tan Daoji achieved nothing and came back empty, and within months of the accession the Lesser Emperor had this man of merit put to death, so that the court had no commander of standing left who dared take the field, and in the early years of Yuanjia it turned instead to excluding the old families and promoting men of humble origin. For Tuoba Tao the result was strategic rather than decisive: he had confirmed his judgement that the southern frontier lay open and could be struck at will, but he had also seen that the southern court still had the will to hold its cities and still had generals, so for several years he came south with the whole empire no more, and used annual raids and piecemeal encroachment instead, putting his strength where it would expand most. Thus the two sides opened a long war of attrition across the plains of Henan, one that lasted more than forty years and was not broken until Wei itself split and the southern counter-offensives failed.
